kebab_example: aliyun gws create-instance --cluster-id gws-xxx --image-id m-xxx --system-disk-size 100 --system-disk-category cloud_ssd --instance-type ecs.g6.large --work-mode Desktop --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateInstance

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID.
If specified, the instance is created in this vSwitch. Specify this parameter when you create an instance to define the CIDR block and zone of the instance.
If not specified, the system automatically selects the latest active zone with available inventory based on the current instance type (for example, China (Beijing) Zone G).
    * If a vSwitch already exists in the zone, the system uses the existing vSwitch.
    * If no vSwitch exists in the zone, the system attempts automatic creation
parameters.help_zh:
交换机 id。
当指定时，选用此交换机来创建实例。推荐在创建时使用此参数，以限定实例的网段与可用区。
当不指定时，后台会根据当前实例类型，找到有库存的最新可用区（例如华北 2 可用区 G ），如果此可用区
    * 已有交换机，则直接选用
    * 没有交换机，则会尝试自动创建
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The system cloud disk size. Unit: GB.
Valid values: 20 to 500.
When you select an image, the system cloud disk size must be greater than or equal to the image size
parameters.help_zh:
系统盘大小，单位为 GB。
取值范围 20~500。
选取不同镜像时，要求系统盘大小 >= 镜像的大小
parameters.name: system_disk_size

parameters.help_en:
The category of the system cloud disk. Valid values:
cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
cloud_essd: Enterprise SSD (ESSD). Only instances of newer instance families, such as ecs.g6, support ESSDs
parameters.help_zh:
系统盘的种类：
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。
cloud_essd：ESSD 云盘。（只有较新规格族的实例，例如 ecs.g6 系统，才支持 ESSD 云盘）
parameters.name: system_disk_category

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to assign a public IP address. Valid values:
True
False
parameters.help_zh:
是否分配公网地址
True
False
parameters.name: allocate_public_address

parameters.help_en:
This parameter takes effect only when AllocatePublicAddress is set to true.

The billing method for network usage. Valid values:

PayByTraffic (default): pay-by-traffic.
PayByBandwidth: pay-by-bandwidth
parameters.help_zh:
此值只在 `AllocatePublicAddress` 为 `true` 时有效

网络计费类型。取值范围：

PayByTraffic（默认）：按使用流量计费
PayByBandwidth：按固定带宽计费
parameters.name: internet_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
This parameter takes effect only when AllocatePublicAddress is set to true.

The maximum inbound public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s.
Valid values: 1 to 100.
Default value: 4
parameters.help_zh:
此值只在 `AllocatePublicAddress` 为 `true` 时有效

公网入带宽最大值，单位为 Mbps
取值范围 1~100
默认值：4
parameters.name: internet_max_bandwidth_in

parameters.help_en:
This parameter takes effect only when AllocatePublicAddress is set to true.

The maximum outbound public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s.
Valid values: 1 to 100.
Default value: 4
parameters.help_zh:
此值只在 `AllocatePublicAddress` 为 `true` 时有效

公网出带宽最大值，单位为 Mbps
取值范围 1~100
默认值：4
parameters.name: internet_max_bandwidth_out

parameters.help_en: The instance type. For more information, see Instance families (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html) or call DescribeInstanceTypes (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25620.html) to query available instance types
parameters.help_zh: 实例规格，请参见 实例规格族 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html) 或调用 DescribeInstanceTypes (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25620.html) 获得规格表
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:
PostPaid (default): pay-as-you-go.
PrePaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
实例付费方式：
PostPaid（默认）：按量付费
PrePaid：包年包月
parameters.name: instance_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:
False (default)
True
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费：
False（默认）
True
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
This parameter takes effect only when InstanceChargeType is set to PrePaid (subscription).

The subscription duration.
If PeriodUnit is set to Week, valid values are 1 to 4.
If PeriodUnit is set to Month, valid values are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, 36, 48, and 60
parameters.help_zh:
此值仅在 `InstanceChargeType` 为 `PrePaid`（包年包月）时有效。

包年包月的时长。
`PeriodUnit` 为 `Week`（周）时，取值范围 1~4
`PeriodUnit` 为 `Month`（月）时，取值范围 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 12 24 36 48 60
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
This parameter takes effect only when InstanceChargeType is set to PrePaid (subscription).

The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:
Week
Month
parameters.help_zh:
此值仅在 `InstanceChargeType` 为 `PrePaid`（包年包月）时有效。

包年包月的单位。
Week
Month
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en:
The work mode. Valid values:
Desktop: desktop mode.
Application: application mode
parameters.help_zh:
工作模式：
Desktop：桌面模式。
Application：应用模式
parameters.name: work_mode

fields.help_en:
This parameter takes effect only when WorkMode is set to Application.

The runtime parameters of the application. Valid values of N in AppList.N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh:
此值仅在 `WorkMode` 为 `Application` 时有效。

应用的运行参数。其中 AppList.N 的允许范围是 1~10
fields.name: app_args

fields.help_en:
This parameter takes effect only when WorkMode is set to Application.

The application name. Valid values of N in AppList.N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh:
此值仅在 `WorkMode` 为 `Application` 时有效。

应用名称。其中 AppList.N 的允许范围是 1~10
fields.name: app_name

fields.help_en:
This parameter takes effect only when WorkMode is set to Application.

The execution path of the application. Valid values of N in AppList.N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh:
此值仅在 `WorkMode` 为 `Application` 时有效。

应用的运行路径。其中 AppList.N 的允许范围是 1~10
fields.name: app_path
